  <!ELEMENT doc (section+)>

  <!ENTITY e2 "&e1; and Entity 2">

  %pe;
]>
<?target data="processing-instruction"?>
<doc xmlns="http://ns.example.com/doc" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
  <!-- Documentation section comment -->
  <section xlink:type="simple">
    <![CDATA[
      Unparsed character data with markup: <section>test</section>
    ]]>
  </section>
  <section>&e3;</section>
</doc>

<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (item*)>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY base "Catalog Base">
  <!ENTITY derived "&base; - Extended">
  <!NOTATION pdf SYSTEM "application/pdf">
  <!ENTITY manual SYSTEM "manual.pdf" NDATA pdf>
  <!ENTITY % ext-dtd SYSTEM "external.dtd">
  %ext-dtd;
]>
<?xml-log level="debug" target="parser"?>
<catalog xmlns="http://catalog.org/ns" xmlns:m="http://catalog.org/ns/meta">
  <!-- Header comment for catalog -->
  <m:metadata>
    <?m:action type="initialize"?>
    <![CDATA[
      <!ENTITY internal-cdata-test "should not expand">
    ]]>
  </m:metadata>
  <item>&derived;</item>
</catalog>

<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE system [
  <!ELEMENT system (node)*>
  <!ELEMENT node (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY token "SecurityToken">
  <!ENTITY auth "&token;-Verified">
  <!ENTITY % dtd-frag "
    <!NOTATION txt SYSTEM 'text/plain'>
    <!ENTITY doc-file 'readme.txt' NDATA txt>
  ">
  %dtd-frag;
]>
<?xml-audit log="enabled"?>
<system xmlns="http://system.net/ns" xmlns:sec="http://system.net/ns/security">
  <!-- Security boundary configuration comment -->
  <sec:policy id="p1">
    <?sec:enforce mode="strict"?>
    <![CDATA[
      Protected zone CDATA: <sec:policy>untrusted</sec:policy>
    ]]>
  </sec:policy>
  <node>&auth;</node>
</system>
